title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 — EUR-Lex
snippet: Article 62 requires member states to facilitate access to regulatory sandboxes for SMEs and start-ups. Providers that are micro or small enterprises may benefit from reduced fees and simplified procedures for conformity assessments.

title: Article 52 - EU AI Act
snippet: SME-specific provisions include proportionate application of obligations and simplified technical documentation. Regulatory sandboxes under Article 62 allow controlled testing environments with reduced compliance requirements.

title: EU regulatory framework for AI - European Commission
snippet: The European Commission has introduced measures to support SMEs including lighter-touch supervision, regulatory sandboxes accessible to startups, and phased implementation timelines that give smaller companies more time to comply.
